description: unknowns — the IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md deviation reminder with its SessionStart, post-compaction and Stop context lines, and a read-only Bash guard for the plugin's sub-agents. Behavior and UNKNOWNS_* variables: README.md, "Hook behavior and configuration".

hooks.command: echo `# <#` >/dev/null; s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/agent_readonly_guard.py"; for p in python3 python "py -3"; do [ "${OS-}" != Windows_NT ] || $p -c 0 </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; exec $p "$s"; done; echo "[unknowns] no working Python 3 found (tried python3, python, py -3)" >&2; exit 1 #> > $null; $s = "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/agent_readonly_guard.py"; foreach ($p in 'python3', 'python', 'py') { $a = @(); if ($p -eq 'py') { $a = @('-3') }; if (Get-Command $p -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { & $p @a -c 0 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & $p @a $s; exit $LASTEXITCODE } } }; [Console]::Error.WriteLine('[unknowns] no working Python 3 found (tried python3, python, py -3)'); exit 1
